runs.text: Do not write code. Write four prices with the right answer for each one, so that any wrong version of the money box fails at least one of them.

hints.text: Write the worked examples of the card. Which ones are edge cases?
Imagine possible errors: a condition that is off by one, a box that starts wrong, two lines in another order. Which price uncovers them?
You need a price that is gathered exactly and one that is enough on the first day.
50, 54, 2 and 1000, with their answers from the lesson, uncover every wrong version. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Which of the four prices could you remove without letting any wrong version escape? (Try it: the app tells you which one survives.)

in the condition, the money box starting at 0, adding before increasing what is saved each day, and the day starting at 0. A set without an exact price (such as 54) and without one less than or equal to 2 does not detect the first one.
